news.title: Filip Forsberg has 2 goals, Juuse Saros gets shutout in Predators' 5th straight win, 3-0 over Kings
news.ruTitle: У Филипа Форсберга 2 гола, Юусе Сарос забивает в пятую победу подряд "Хищников" со счетом 3:0 над "Кингз"
news.description: — Filip Forsberg scored two goals, Juuse Saros made 30 saves in his 28th career shutout and the Nashville Predators extended their winning streak to five games with a 3-0 victory over the Los Angeles Kings on Tuesday night.

news.title: Connor Hellebuyck booed pregame in Winnipeg return as Jets go on to beat Devils
news.ruTitle: Коннора Хеллебака освистали перед игрой в возвращении в Виннипег, когда Джетс обыграли Дьяволов
news.description: Although he did not play Tuesday night in his return to Winnipeg after being traded to New Jersey, goaltender Connor Hellebuyck was booed when he took the ice for the Devils' pregame warmup.

news.title: Snuggerud's goal, assist help power the Blues to a 3-2 victory over the Red Wings
news.ruTitle: Гол Снуггеруда и результативная передача помогли «синим» одержать победу над «Ред Уингз» со счетом 3:2.
news.description: — Jimmy Snuggerud had a goal and an assist and his score in the third period was the winner as the St. Louis Blues beat the Detroit Red Wings 3-2 on Tuesday night.

news.title: Mercer, Connor each score twice to lift Jets to an emotional 4-2 win over Devils
news.ruTitle: Мерсер и Коннор забили по два гола, что привело Джетс к эмоциональной победе над Девилз со счетом 4:2.
news.description: — Dawson Mercer and Kyle Connor each scored twice to lead the Winnipeg Jets to an emotional 4-2 victory over the New Jersey Devils on Tuesday night.

news.title: Kaprizov's power-play goal in the 1st minute of OT lifts Wild past the Canadiens 2-1
news.ruTitle: Гол Капризова в большинстве на 1-й минуте овертайма позволил Уайлду обыграть Канадиенс со счетом 2:1.
news.description: — Kirill Kaprizov scored on a power play in the opening minute of overtime and Jesper Wallstedt made 27 saves as the Minnesota Wild beat the Montreal Canadiens 2-1 on Tuesday night after Carey Price was inducted into the team's ring of honor.

news.title: Hutson's goal 74 seconds into overtime lifts Capitals past Senators 3-2
news.ruTitle: Гол Хатсона на 74-й секунде овертайма помог "Кэпиталз" опередить сенаторов со счетом 3-2
news.description: — Cole Hutson’s goal 74 seconds into overtime, set up by Alex Ovechkin, gave the Washington Capitals to a 3-2 win over the Ottawa Senators on Tuesday night.

news.title: Landeskog scores twice and the Avalanche hand the Maple Leafs their 4th straight loss, 6-3
news.ruTitle: Ландеског забивает дважды, а «Эвеланш» приносят «Мэйпл Лифс» четвертое поражение подряд – 6–3.
news.description: — Gabriel Landeskog scored his second goal of the game early in the third period to put the Colorado Avalanche ahead for good in a 6-3 win over the Toronto Maple Leafs on Tuesday night.

news.title: Sources: Flyers have not received formal trade request from Matvei Michkov
news.ruTitle: Источники: Flyers не получила официального торгового запроса от Матвея Мичкова.
news.description: The Flyers have not received a formal trade request from Matvei Michkov and were surprised to hear he wanted to play elsewhere, sources told ESPN on Tuesday.

news.title: NHL general managers discuss ways technology can help officials at fall meeting
news.ruTitle: Генеральные менеджеры НХЛ обсуждают, как технологии могут помочь чиновникам на осенней встрече
news.description: At the annual fall meeting that follows Hockey Hall of Fame weekend in Toronto, NHL general managers discussed ways to use technology and other means to help on-ice officials, among other topics, on Tuesday.

news.title: Kings expect to get Kevin Fiala back this week, sources say
news.ruTitle: Источники сообщают, что «Кингз» рассчитывают вернуть Кевина Фиалу на этой неделе.
news.description: Kevin Fiala is expected to make his season debut this week, sources told ESPN's Emily Kaplan, with the Kings also slated to get Mats Zuccarello back Tuesday night.

news.title: Connor Hellebuyck discusses why he wanted out of Winnipeg
news.ruTitle: Коннор Хеллебак рассказал, почему он хотел покинуть Виннипег
news.description: Connor Hellebuyck talks a little bit about why he wanted out of Winnipeg.

news.title: Ovechkin says Russians want to play for country, doesn't weigh in on worlds
news.ruTitle: Овечкин говорит, что россияне хотят играть за сборную, но не имеет значения для чемпионата мира
news.description: Alex Ovechkin didn't weigh in on CAS' decision to allow Russian players back in hockey worlds, but said they just want to represent their country.
